query:
UPDATE users
            SET auto_topup_amount = 25.0,
                auto_topup_threshold = 10.0,
                auto_topup_monthly_limit = 100.0,
                auto_topup_soft_failure_count = $2,
                auto_topup_retry_after = CASE
                    WHEN $2 = 0 THEN NULL
                    ELSE NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute'
                END,
                payment_provider_id = $3
            WHERE id = $1
